meta.title: Aegis Guard standards watch register
meta.purpose: References to harmonised standards and related instruments under the EU AI Act, with evidence labels and update triggers. References only; no product claims.
meta.checked_by: AI-assisted internal review (not independent external validation)
meta.label_key: VERIFIED | MEASURED | REPORTED | INFERRED | PROVISIONAL | UNREPRODUCIBLE | OWNER DECISION REQUIRED | EXTERNAL REVIEW REQUIRED
meta.access_note: On 2026-10-20 the review environment could not open eur-lex.europa.eu, cencenelec.eu, digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu or the secondary pages (network policy). Every status below is therefore REPORTED from search-result summaries unless stated. No primary text was read.

primary_references.title: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2026/2274 citing EN 18286:2026 as a harmonised standard (Art. 40 AI Act)
primary_references.url_status: Constructed from the standard ELI pattern; not opened.
primary_references.label: REPORTED
primary_references.basis: Secondary summaries (law-firm, compliance-vendor and news pages) and the CEN and CENELEC post forwarded by the owner. The OJ date rests on one secondary source.
to_verify: Decision number, adoption and OJ publication dates
Wording of Article 1 and the Annex
Whether any restriction or reservation is stated
primary_references.required_action: EXTERNAL REVIEW REQUIRED: read the OJ text before any external use.

primary_references.title: EN 18286:2026 Annex ZA (Table ZA.1): which AI Act requirements the presumption covers
primary_references.url_status: URL already recorded in data.json (id en-18286); not opened in this review.
primary_references.label: REPORTED
primary_references.basis: Secondary sources say Table ZA.1 maps Article 17(1) points (a) to (m) and the first sentence of Article 11(1); Article 17(2)-(4) are reported as not covered; Article 72 is reported as having no Annex ZA row. Sources disagree on detail.
to_verify: Full Table ZA.1 and the conditions on each row
Whether Art. 17(2)-(4) and Art. 72 are excluded
Any Annex ZB or similar caveat
primary_references.required_action: OWNER DECISION REQUIRED: obtain the standard text (via the Irish national standards body or CEN-CENELEC) before mapping clauses.

watch_items.watch: Corrigenda, amendments or withdrawal of Implementing Decision (EU) 2026/2274
watch_items.why: Any change alters or removes the presumption.

watch_items.watch: Further JTC 21 harmonised standards and their OJ citation (risk management, data governance, record-keeping/logging, human oversight, accuracy/robustness, cybersecurity, conformity assessment)
watch_items.why: The record-keeping and cybersecurity standards are the closest fit to Aegis Guard's Article 12 and gateway-security functions. Draft numbers and status are not verified here.
watch_items.check: CEN-CENELEC JTC 21 work programme; Commission standardisation page
watch_items.label: REPORTED (delivery expected end of 2026 at the earliest per search summaries)

watch_items.watch: Digital Omnibus on AI: final text, dates for Annex III and Annex I high-risk obligations, and any link between application dates and standards availability
watch_items.why: aegis-guard.html cites Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 and a 2 Dec 2027 date; those claims were not re-verified in this review.
watch_items.check: EUR-Lex; Council and Parliament press pages
watch_items.label: UNVERIFIED in this review

watch_items.watch: Availability and price of the standard through the Irish national standards body
watch_items.why: Needed to map Aegis Guard evidence to clauses.

watch_items.watch: Commission guidelines on high-risk classification and on Article 17 QMS expectations
watch_items.why: May change how providers use the standard.

update_protocol: Re-check each primary reference and watch item at the agreed cadence.
Record the check date and what was actually opened. If a primary source could not be opened, say so and leave the label at REPORTED.
Never promote a label to VERIFIED without reading the primary text.
Do not change public site copy (data.json, legislation.html, aegis-guard.html) without an owner decision.
